message:
Blog post slugs now keep accented letters' base letters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFKD) and strips the combining marks before calling the vendored `slugify`. I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to hand-edit vendored code.

The product URLs in `src/shop/product-url.js` use the same vendored `slugify`, so product names with accents will still lose those letters. I left that alone since you asked about blog posts. If you want it fixed too, it's a one-line change there, or it can be fixed once in the vendor library upgrade.

I haven't committed anything.
